<?php
/**
 * AsyncCryptoService - Handles asynchronous cryptographic operations
 * with server-side template rendering for audit logs
 */

namespace CryptoLib\Services;

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use React\EventLoop\LoopInterface;

class AsyncCryptoService
{
    private $loop;
    private $auditLogPath;
    private $templateEngine;
    private $keyStore;
    private $nonceRegistry;

    public function __construct(LoopInterface $loop, string $auditLogPath)
    {
        $this->loop = $loop;
        $this->auditLogPath = $auditLogPath;
        $this->templateEngine = new AuditTemplateEngine();
        $this->keyStore = new KeyStore();
        $this->nonceRegistry = new NonceRegistry();
    }

    public function encryptAsync(string $plaintext, string $keyId, array $metadata = []): PromiseInterface
    {
        return $this->resolveKeyAsync($keyId)->then(function ($key) use ($plaintext, $metadata, $keyId) {
            $nonce = $this->generateNonce();
            $ciphertext = $this->performEncryption($plaintext, $key, $nonce);
            
            $auditEntry = $this->buildAuditEntry('encrypt', $keyId, $metadata);
            $this->writeAuditLog($auditEntry);
            
            return [
                'ciphertext' => base64_encode($ciphertext),
                'nonce' => base64_encode($nonce),
                'key_id' => $keyId,
                'timestamp' => time()
            ];
        });
    }

    public function decryptAsync(string $ciphertextB64, string $nonceB64, string $keyId, array $metadata = []): PromiseInterface
    {
        return $this->resolveKeyAsync($keyId)->then(function ($key) use ($ciphertextB64, $nonceB64, $metadata, $keyId) {
            $ciphertext = base64_decode($ciphertextB64, true);
            $nonce = base64_decode($nonceB64, true);

            if ($ciphertext === false || $nonce === false) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid base64 input');
            }

            if (strlen($nonce) !== SODIUM_CRYPTO_SECRETBOX_NONCEBYTES) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid nonce length');
            }
            
            if (!$this->nonceRegistry->validate($nonce)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Nonce replay detected');
            }
            
            $plaintext = $this->performDecryption($ciphertext, $key, $nonce);
            
            $auditEntry = $this->buildAuditEntry('decrypt', $keyId, $metadata);
            $this->writeAuditLog($auditEntry);
            
            return ['plaintext' => $plaintext, 'key_id' => $keyId];
        });
    }

    private function resolveKeyAsync(string $keyId): PromiseInterface
    {
        $deferred = new \React\Promise\Deferred();
        
        $this->loop->addTimer(0.001, function () use ($deferred, $keyId) {
            $key = $this->keyStore->resolve($keyId);
            if ($key === null) {
                $deferred->reject(new \RuntimeException("Key not found: {$keyId}"));
            } else {
                $deferred->resolve($key);
            }
        });
        
        return $deferred->promise();
    }

    private function buildAuditEntry(string $operation, string $keyId, array $metadata): string
    {
        $context = [
            'operation' => $operation,
            'key_id' => $keyId,
            'timestamp' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            'client_info' => $metadata['client_info'] ?? 'unknown',
            'request_id' => $metadata['request_id'] ?? $this->generateRequestId()
        ];
        
        return $this->templateEngine->render($context);
    }

    private function writeAuditLog(string $entry): void
    {
        $logFile = $this->auditLogPath . '/crypto_audit.log';
        file_put_contents($logFile, $entry . "\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }

    private function performEncryption(string $plaintext, string $key, string $nonce): string
    {
        return sodium_crypto_secretbox($plaintext, $nonce, $key);
    }

    private function performDecryption(string $ciphertext, string $key, string $nonce): string
    {
        $result = sodium_crypto_secretbox_open($ciphertext, $nonce, $key);
        if ($result === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Decryption failed - authentication error');
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function generateNonce(): string
    {
        $nonce = random_bytes(SODIUM_CRYPTO_SECRETBOX_NONCEBYTES);
        $this->nonceRegistry->register($nonce);
        return $nonce;
    }

    private function generateRequestId(): string
    {
        return bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    }
}

class AuditTemplateEngine
{
    private $templateDir;

    public function __construct(string $templateDir = null)
    {
        $this->templateDir = $templateDir ?? __DIR__ . '/templates';
    }

    /**
     * Renders audit context into a log-compatible format.
     * Sanitizes all values to prevent log injection.
     */
    public function render(array $context): string
    {
        $template = $this->loadTemplate('audit_entry');
        
        foreach ($context as $key => $value) {
            $placeholder = '{{' . $key . '}}';
            $template = str_replace($placeholder, $this->formatValue($value), $template);
        }
        
        return $template;
    }

    private function loadTemplate(string $name): string
    {
        $path = $this->templateDir . '/' . $name . '.tpl';
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            return file_get_contents($path);
        }
        // Default plaintext template for log aggregation
        return '[{{timestamp}}] Op: {{operation}} | Key: {{key_id}} | Client: {{client_info}} | ReqID: {{request_id}}';
    }

    private function formatValue($value): string
    {
        if (is_array($value)) {
            $encoded = json_encode($value);
        } else {
            $encoded = (string) $value;
        }
        // Strip any SSI directives and HTML comments that could be interpreted
        $encoded = preg_replace('/<!--.*?-->/', '', $encoded);
        // Remove any remaining angle bracket sequences
        $encoded = str_replace(['<', '>'], ['<', '>'], $encoded);
        return $encoded;
    }
}

class KeyStore
{
    private $keys = [];

    public function resolve(string $keyId): ?string
    {
        return $this->keys[$keyId] ?? null;
    }

    public function register(string $keyId, string $key): void
    {
        if (strlen($key) !== SODIUM_CRYPTO_SECRETBOX_KEYBYTES) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid key length');
        }
        $this->keys[$keyId] = $key;
    }
}

class NonceRegistry
{
    private $usedNonces = [];

    public function register(string $nonce): void
    {
        $this->usedNonces[bin2hex($nonce)] = time();
    }

    public function validate(string $nonce): bool
    {
        $hex = bin2hex($nonce);
        // A nonce is only valid if it has NOT been seen before (prevents replay).
        if (isset($this->usedNonces[$hex])) {
            return false;
        }
        // Record the nonce so it cannot be reused.
        $this->usedNonces[$hex] = time();
        return true;
    }
}
